sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm back in my hotel room after a long day.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My phone isn't charging, so I call reception for help.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, the socket by my bed doesn't work.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry about that, does your charger work anywhere else?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, it worked at the airport this morning.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Is the lamp plugged into that same socket working?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: No, the lamp's off too, so there's no power there.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Thanks, we'll send someone up to check that socket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: What can I do to charge my phone tonight?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Come down to reception, we've got a power bank to lend.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I go downstairs to speak to the same receptionist.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, I'm from room twelve, we just spoke on the phone.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, here's the power bank we talked about.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I borrow a power bank for my room, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, just connect your charging cable to it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, then I won't need the room socket to charge.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can borrow it overnight, but we'll need it back by ten tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what time do you need the power bank back?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: By ten tomorrow morning, here at reception.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I connect my phone and check that it's charging.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's charging now, thanks for helping me out.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, we'll let you know when we've checked the socket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I contact reception if the socket still doesn't work?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, call us from your room and we'll help.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I leave the power bank in the drawer tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Please bring it back here, so we know you've returned it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll bring it back to this desk tomorrow morning.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, take the power bank with you to your room.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I can charge my phone while someone checks the socket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got power for my phone while I wait for help.
